title: PERSUBENTMGR ACadSharp cross-version DXF projection and DWG parser conflict
scope: Hash-bound local AutoCAD SAVEAS sample pairs and LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON/trace observations for PERSUBENTMGR handle 0xD63

generator_routes: ASCII DXF SAVEAS outputs are generated for AC1015 through AC1032; no AC1014 ASCII DXF output appears in this script

reader.name: LibreDWG
reader.note: The PERSUBENTMGR class is marked Unstable Class by LibreDWG. minJSON output is a peer parser observation, not an authoritative schema.

object_observations: PERSUBENTMGR type 549, handle 0xD63, object size 24 bytes, bitsize 150
LibreDWG reports common_size 68 bits and then class_version=2, unknown_0=0, unknown_2=2, numassocsteps=4, numassocsubents=0, num_steps=2, steps 3 and 4
The candidate next field decodes as num_subents=4, after which byte reads overrun the 24-byte object; reported subents are not trustworthy

libdxfrw_readback.strict_export_result: refused before output due to unrelated DWG IMAGEDEF/reactor source-capture failure

interpretation: The AC1015/AC1021/AC1024 paired DXF objects project exactly eight group-90 values: class_version, two unknown scalars, association step count, association subentity count, step-vector count, and two step values under the candidate mapping. No additional group-90 num_subents value is present in those object records.
The AC1027/AC1032 paired DXF objects project six group-90 values: the first three candidate scalars followed by zero association counts; no num_steps, num_subents, or vector values are present.

This is cross-version DXF projection evidence, not proof of the DWG body field spans. For AC1015, the peer DWG parser tries to consume a further count and overruns; its decoded subents must not be treated as valid values.
decision: Keep PERSUBENTMGR evidence partial and raw-carried. Preserve only the existing narrowly source-bound AC1021/AC1024 partial-prefix callbacks; do not mark a body Complete or promote the candidate num_subents interpretation, conditional omission rule, strict DXF output, or semantic support.

change: The DWG dispatcher now treats every non-Complete PERSUBENTMGR prefix status, including Missing on legacy AC1018 and earlier profiles, as insufficient evidence to mark the raw payload typed-validated. It retains the callback contract and raw frame.

The AC1024 bounded partial-prefix admission now includes the hash-bound D63 profile [class_version=2, unknown_0=0, unknown_2=2, numassocsteps=4, numassocsubents=0, num_steps=2, steps=[3,4]]. It does not read a trailing num_subents count and the raw carrier stays unvalidated.
implementation_update.regression: Generated AC1018 PERSUBENTMGR controls verify Missing body status, unvalidated raw payload, raw frame publication, and following-object recovery. Generated AC1024 mode 7 exercises the D63 [3,4] partial prefix and following frame.

physical_readback.strict_output: refused because standalone DWG OBJECTCONTEXTDATA has no qualified replay path

next: Capture an independent bit-span trace for the D63 DWG object in AC1015/AC1021/AC1024 and identify exact class-body end, any trailing count bits, the object handle-stream start, and versioned padding. Reconcile those spans with paired DXF group-90 projections before broadening any typed-prefix path. Preserve the existing AC1021/AC1024 profile gates and generated truncation/retry tests.
